# Wet'nJoy Lonavala

> > Wet'nJoy Lonavala is a premier water and amusement park located on Old Pune Mumbai Highway NH-4 in Lonavala, Maharashtra, offering 26+ international rides, India's largest wave pool, and family entertainment.

The park features thrilling attractions like Master Blaster, Tornado, and Sky Screamer, plus add-on experiences including Horror House and Mirror Maze. Located conveniently between Mumbai and Pune, Wet'nJoy is accessible via Magic Pass for multi-park adventures across 7 entertainment destinations operated by Imagicaaworld Entertainment Ltd.
